task: Task 2 (re-record and re-run the 46-case planner evalset on gemini-3.5-flash, prompt v7, plus cheap cards)
prices: config/models.toml [pricing]: $1.65 per 1M input tokens, $9.90 per 1M output tokens (thinking tokens billed as output), cached input at 10% of the input price; list prices, a modelled figure, not a billing-export number

runs.what: single-gap smoke test of credentials, tap and fallback detection (gap_tea_ds04, prompt v7); output discarded
runs.tokens_source: usage_metadata of each model response, logged by the usage tap (model_calls_00_smoke_tea.jsonl); exact, not estimated

runs.what: RUN 1, recording: one real planner run for each of the 46 evalset gaps; the expected trajectories of the re-recorded evalsets (eval/raw/planner_traces_2026-10-14/)
runs.tokens_source: usage_metadata of each model response, logged by the usage tap (model_calls_01_record.jsonl); exact, not estimated

runs.what: RUN 2, verification: adk eval of the 46 re-recorded evalsets against the live model (eval/raw/live_eval_2026-10-14/adk_vertex/)
runs.command: harness.run_evals (adk eval, inference parallelism lowered to 2 by the tap; observed max 1 model call in flight)
runs.tokens_source: usage_metadata of each model response, logged by the usage tap (model_calls_02_verify.jsonl); exact, not estimated

runs.what: vision card: 30 staged synthetic photos through agents.capture.vision.intake (eval/raw/live_eval_2026-10-14/vision_synthetic.json)
runs.tokens_source: usage_metadata of each response, recorded in vision_synthetic.json calls[]; exact

runs.what: chat latency card: 50 POST /chat calls to a local API process (eval/raw/customer_latency_2026-10-14/)
runs.tokens_source: usage_metadata of each model response, logged by the usage tap (model_calls_04_chat.jsonl); exact, not estimated

stopped_because: a third planner run costs about $3.6 and would take Task 2 spend to about $12, over the $10 cap, so it was not started; the 190-persona agent simulation was not started (cost unknown, no margin)
tooling: usage_tap_sitecustomize.py in this folder (copy to a scratch dir as sitecustomize.py and put that dir on PYTHONPATH; env TAAL_TAP_LOG, TAAL_TAP_CAP_USD, TAAL_TAP_PRIOR_USD) wraps every planner/chat model call, logs model requested, model_version reported by the server and usage_metadata, stops the process before a call that would pass the cap, and lowers adk eval parallelism to 2.
